title: Transcontinental Inc. – Release of Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2026 Results, and Conference Call
text: MONTREAL, Nov. 25, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- On Wednesday, December 9, 2026, Transcontinental Inc. will release its fourth quarter and fiscal 2026 results...
fullText:
MONTREAL, Nov. 25, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- On Wednesday, December 9, 2026, Transcontinental Inc. will release its fourth quarter and fiscal 2026 results after market close. The financial results will be made public in a press release that will be issued on the newswire as well as in the Management’s Discussion and Analysis that will be posted on the Corporation’s website.

The Corporation will also host a conference call for the financial community on Thursday, December 10, at 8:00 a.m. The conference call will be broadcast live (audio only) on the Investors homepage of the Corporation’s website at www.tc.tc, and will be archived for 30 days.

FOURTH QUARTER AND FISCAL YEAR 2026 RESULTS CONFERENCE CALL
